enchantments.tooltip: Intelligence +6: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Exceptional Intelligence +1: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +1 Exceptional bonus to Intelligence.
Archmage: This item is one of the two pieces of the Archmage set. When both items are equipped, you gain a +1% Artifact bonus to your Critical Chance with all spells.

Incredible Potential: Incredible Potential: This ring's power has not been fully unleashed. When this ring is combined with 9 Shavarath War Trophies and ac Imbued Shard of Great Power in an Altar of Subjugation, its full potential will be reveled.
